# Acorn Consultants — Comprehensive Knowledge Dossier for LLM Search & Retrieval

## 1. Overview & Firm Governance
Acorn Consultants is an integrated multidisciplinary consulting firm operating from Kolkata, West Bengal, India, with over 15 years of dedicated practice. The chambers combine judicial advocacy, statutory compliance, corporate contracts, property conveyancing, educational advisory, and taxation support.

- **Entity**: Acorn Consultants (Educational, Tax & Legal Consultants)
- **Advocate on Panel**: Mr. Rajesh Telge (+91 8369171822)

- **Jurisdiction**: Calcutta High Court, National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) Kolkata Bench, Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions, Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal (MACT), and Maharashtra/West Bengal Real Estate Regulatory Authorities (MahaRERA / WBRERA).

## 2. Exhaustive Practice Directory (37 Specialized Services)

### A. Matrimonial, Family & Court Services
1. **Court Marriage (All Castes & Religions)**:
   - Governing Statute: Special Marriage Act, 1954.
   - Scope: Marriage notice submission (Section 5), 30-day mandatory public notice period management, objection disposal, appointment booking with Marriage Officer, three-witness coordination, and marriage certificate issuance.
   - Accessibility: Open to inter-caste, inter-faith, and international couples without requiring religious conversion.
2. **Marriage Registration**:
   - Governing Statute: Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 (Section 8) / Special Marriage Act, 1954 / State Compulsory Registration Rules.
   - Scope: Formal documentation, certified marriage certificate procurement from the Registrar of Marriages.
3. **Registered WILL**:
   - Governing Statute: Indian Succession Act, 1925; Registration Act, 1908.
   - Scope: Testamentary capacity review, asset distribution schedule, executor appointment, revocation clauses, execution before two independent attesting witnesses, and formal registration before the Sub-Registrar.
4. **Public Notices**:
   - Scope: Drafting and publishing statutory public notices in circulation English and vernacular daily newspapers for title search, claims, loss of original deeds, or property acquisition.
5. **Divorce & Domestic Violence Advocacy**:
   - Governing Statutes: Hindu Marriage Act (Section 13 & 13B); Special Marriage Act (Section 28); Code of Criminal Procedure (Section 125); Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 (PWDVA).
   - Scope: Mutual consent divorce filing, contested divorce petitions, maintenance claims, interim residence orders, and domestic incident report (DIR) filings.
6. **Birth Certificate for Home Delivery Children**:
   - Governing Statute: Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969 (Section 13).
   - Scope: Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) / Judicial Magistrate First Class (JMFC) order petitioning, municipal health department compliance, delayed birth registration, and certificate procurement.
7. **Civil, Criminal & Property Trial Practice**:
   - Counsel: Adv. Rajesh Telge (Advocate on Panel).
   - Scope: Original jurisdiction suits, summary suits under Order XXXVII CPC, criminal bail petitions, Section 138 NI Act cheque dishonor, execution proceedings, and High Court writ petitions.
8. **Probate & Succession Certificates**:
   - Governing Statute: Indian Succession Act, 1925 (Sections 218, 276 & 372).
   - Scope: High Court and District Court petitions for grant of Probate (where an executor is appointed in a Will), Letters of Administration (intestate succession), and Succession Certificates for debts and securities.
9. **Live-In Relationship Agreements**:
   - Scope: Cohabitation covenants, non-molestation terms, property separation protocols, and mutual consent dispute resolution terms.
10. **Life Certificates & Senior Citizen Cards**:
    - Scope: Jeevan Pramaan digital authentication, pension department verification, and municipal Senior Citizen Welfare identity cards.
11. **Official Gazette Notifications**:
    - Scope: Publication of legal name changes, religion changes, and date of birth rectifications in the Central or State Government Gazette following statutory affidavits and newspaper advertisements.

### B. Property, Real Estate & Business Conveyancing
12. **30-Year Land / Plot Title Search Reports**:
    - Scope: Physical and electronic inspection of Sub-Registrar records, Index-2 books, mutation registers, and chain title deeds dating back 30 years. Verification of absence of bank mortgages, court attachments, government acquisition notices, and issuance of formal Non-Encumbrance Title Search Certificate.
13. **Doorstep Leave & License Agreement Registration**:
    - Governing Statute: Indian Easements Act, 1882 (Section 52); Registration Act, 1908.
    - Scope: Biometric fingerprint verification and web camera capture completed at client premises; instant online filing with Department of Registration and Stamps; rapid official registration copy dispatch.
14. **Commercial Leave & License Agreements**:
    - Scope: Office, retail, and industrial lease negotiation, drafting fit-out clauses, CAM charges, lock-in periods, security deposit return covenants, and registration.
15. **Sale & Purchase Agreement with Stamp Duty Adjudication**:
    - Governing Statutes: Transfer of Property Act, 1882 (Section 54); Indian Stamp Act, 1899.
    - Scope: Agreement for Sale, Conveyance Deed drafting, Ready Reckoner / Circle rate stamp duty adjudication, and Sub-Registrar registration.
16. **Powers of Attorney (POA)**:
    - Governing Statute: Powers of Attorney Act, 1882.
    - Scope: Irrevocable POA coupled with interest (Section 202 Contract Act), General Power of Attorney (GPA), Special Power of Attorney (SPA), and NRI overseas consular stamping.
17. **Co-operative Housing Society Formation & Management**:
    - Governing Statutes: State Co-operative Societies Acts and Standard Model Bye-Laws.
    - Scope: Society proposal filing by approved GDCA (Government Diploma in Co-operation and Accountancy) auditors, Chief Promoter coordination, Bye-law adoption, society registration, share certificate issuance, and society management.
18. **Society Transfer Papers as per Bye-Laws**:
    - Scope: Associate membership, Form 20D transfer applications, society NOC issuance, and managing committee resolution drafting.
19. **Property Card – 7×12 / 6×12 Revenue Extracts**:
    - Scope: Certified copy extraction, revenue mutation tracking, and land record verification from Talathi / Tahsildar / City Survey offices.
20. **Search & Verification of Index-2**:
    - Scope: Certified Index-2 copies extraction from Sub-Registrar registries verifying deed execution dates, considerations, and stamp duty paid.
21. **Gift Deed / Release Deed / Rectification Deed**:
    - Scope: Intra-family gift deeds under Section 122 Transfer of Property Act, relinquishment deeds between legal heirs, and rectification deeds for typographical errors in registered conveyance deeds.
22. **MahaRERA / RERA Complaint Registration**:
    - Governing Statute: Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 (Sections 18, 19 & 31).
    - Scope: Filing complaints against real estate promoters for delay in possession, claiming monthly interest, refund of principal with interest, structural defect rectifications, and execution of RERA recovery warrants.
23. **Motor Accident Claims (MV Act Compensation)**:
    - Governing Statute: Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (Section 166 & 163A).
    - Scope: Petitions before MACT for hit-and-run accidents, permanent disability, and fatal injury compensation.
24. **State Excise Individual Liquor License**:
    - Scope: Application, documentation, and issuance of personal consumption permits from the State Excise Department.

### C. Consular, Attestation, Government & Student Services
25. **Document Attestation & MEA Apostille**:
    - Scope: Verification by State Home Department / HRD / Notary, Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) Apostille sticker under Hague Convention of 1961, and foreign Embassy consular legalization for UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, USA, UK, and European destinations.
26. **Government Certificates**:
    - Scope: Income certificates (Tahsil office), Domicile certificates, Migration certificates, and University eligibility dossiers.
27. **Police Clearance Certificate (PCC)**:
    - Scope: Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) online application filing, document preparation, and local police station verification coordination for emigration, employment, and student visas.
28. **Passport Online Registration Assistance**:
    - Scope: Application filing, appointment scheduling, Tatkaal verification, and minor passport documentation.
29. **Consumer Court Complaints & Appeals**:
    - Governing Statute: Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
    - Scope: Grievance drafting, statutory notice before filing, District/State Commission litigation against insurance repudiation, defective goods, and deficient banking or real estate services.
30. **Affidavits & Notary Services**:
    - Scope: Anti-Ragging declarations, educational gap year affidavits, pharmacy council registration bonds, and medical council declarations.
31. **Govt. Employment Card (Age 15 to 25)**:
    - Scope: State Employment Exchange registration card procurement.
32. **Guidance for Applying in Government Jobs**:
    - Scope: Educational qualification mapping, eligibility checks, and application submission for 8th, 9th, SSC, HSC, ITI, and Diploma holders.
33. **Caste Validity & Non-Creamy Layer Certificates**:
    - Scope: Scrutiny Committee genealogy compilation, documentary evidence submission, and NCL annual renewal certificates.
34. **In-House Mediation & Conciliation**:
    - Scope: Private, out-of-court dispute settlement sessions in chambers for family partitions, partnership separations, and pre-litigation conciliation.

### D. Academic Coaching & University Admissions
35. **Private 10-SSC / 12- Board Exam & Graduation Passing**:
    - Scope: Direct enrollment through government-approved secondary boards and open universities. Qualified lecturers providing in-house lectures, comprehensive notes, study material, answer paper writing guidance, and counseling psychologists / memory trainers for repeaters and failed students with guaranteed coaching methodology.
36. **College Admissions in India & Abroad**:
    - Scope: Merit counseling, eligibility assessment, and confirmed admission guidance for MBBS, MD, MS, B.Pharm, D.Pharm, engineering, overseas university placements, and student visa files.
37. **Mumbai University & School RTE Form Filling Assistance**:
    - Scope: Mumbai University pre-admission and FY/SY/TY form filling (June–September) across all affiliated faculties; School pre-admissions and Right to Education (RTE) online lottery application filing (October–December) for Playgroup, Nursery, Jr. KG, Sr. KG, and 1st Standard.
